jobs.title: Sales assistant
jobs.description: Help customers choose clothes, keep the shop tidy and count the till at closing. Hours 8:30 to 17:00, one day off a week.
jobs.requirements: Speaks Amharic and Afaan Oromo or English. Honest and punctual. Some experience helps.

jobs.title: Accounts clerk
jobs.description: Record sales and purchases, prepare monthly reports and keep supplier payments on time. Work with the owner directly.
jobs.requirements: Accounting diploma or equivalent. Excel is essential.

jobs.description: Guard the workshop and yard at night, with a logbook of visitors and deliveries.
